label: Delegation
short: Handing over a multi-step task and checking the result.
strong: You hand over whole tasks and check the result, not each step. That is the largest time saving there is.
edge: Pick one task with three or more steps. Hand the whole thing over, walk away, then check the result.
unmet: Delegation means an agent works through several steps on its own: it reads, decides, writes, checks and reports back.
